notice: Starter dataset, not an exhaustive verified recipe census. Confirmed = recipe spell and reagents visible in OctoWoW DB. Needs verification = database/forum evidence conflicts or ingredient quantities are incomplete.

recipes.name: Elixir of the Mongoose
recipes.sourceNote: OctoWoW spell page lists Mountain Silversage (2), Plaguebloom (2), Crystal Vial.

recipes.name: Flask of the Titans
recipes.sourceNote: OctoWoW DB currently lists Gromsblood (30), Stonescale Oil (10), Black Lotus and Crystal Vial, but a later OctoWoW forum report says the Gromsblood reagent is incorrect and should be Golden Sansam. Do not rely on this recipe until checked in game.

recipes.name: Major Mana Potion
recipes.sourceNote: OctoWoW DB confirms the recipe spell teaches Major Mana Potion, but its spell page did not expose reagent quantities in the retrieved record. Ingredients are intentionally omitted rather than guessed.
